scope: Read-only comparison of existing native captures. No image, game code, world or capture changes.
coordinateConvention: Image origin top-left; rectangles x0,y0,x1,y1 with exclusive right/bottom.
metric: Exact decoded RGBA byte comparison; absolute RGB delta in 0-255 channel units. No alignment, resizing, filtering, or colour conversion beyond decoding to RGBA.

regions.name: right-room-floor
regions.selectionReason: Opaque metal room floor, excluding the left racks/wall and bottom clock HUD.

regions.name: elevator-platform-and-door
regions.selectionReason: Central elevator platform and its solid access door; inside the surrounding frame.

regions.name: lower-centre-room-floor
regions.selectionReason: Opaque room tiles below the elevator; above the crew/filter HUD.

regions.name: interior-wall-shadow-mass
regions.selectionReason: Dark structural fill inside the outer hull, above the elevator.

regions.name: upper-opaque-hull-rail
regions.selectionReason: Inner portion of the top hull rail, away from the silhouette edge.

regions.name: left-opaque-hull-rail
regions.selectionReason: Inner portion of the left vertical hull wall, excluding the outside antialiased rim.

regions.name: exterior-space
regions.selectionReason: Exterior void left of the hull, below deck HUD and above crew HUD.

widerInteriorCoverage.selectionReason: Conservative hull interior inset from the silhouette; includes dark structural mass, elevator, floors and furniture, excluding translucent HUD.

limitations: Evidence is limited to this deck0 elevator view at 48px/cell and simulation tick12000; it is not an all-decks or all-zoom proof.
Opaque surfaces are inferred from the visible existing ship geometry and its draw order; the PNG does not carry an object/material ID buffer.
Exterior contour antialiasing and translucent interface panels are intentionally excluded from the identical-interior claim: their composited pixels may depend on the changed background.
The two builds also contain the textile/ladder revisions. Those objects are outside the selected comparison areas; the unchanged pixels do not isolate every change in the whole build.
This capture contains no natural lake comparison region; this report does not certify lake/shore pixels. Separate dome comparisons are required for that claim.
